version_or_date_checked: 2026-10 (iOS 8.35.0; help center articles updated up to 2026-10-02)
pricing: No free tier; 7-day trial then $15.99/mo or $95.99/yr (US, legacy $12.99/$79.99). Everything incl. logging new workouts is paywalled after trial; Family (Duo/5) annual plans, limited Lifetime at Black Friday, Business seats.
platforms: iOS (iPhone, iOS 18+), Apple Watch, Android, Wear OS, Mac (Apple silicon via App Store); no iPad support; web only for account/subscription
positioning: AI/algorithmic workout generator that builds each session from goal, equipment, per-muscle recovery and logged history, with automatic progressive overload.

features.how: Per-set weight + reps for rep exercises; timed exercises (duration, AMRAP reps in timed intervals); cardio/distance exercises track distance, duration, pace ('Split'); Watch can edit reps, weight, distance, duration, resistance, incline or band per set. Barbell weight can be shown as 'Bar + Plates' or 'Plates Only'; dumbbell weight is per dumbbell (volume doubled). Custom exercises support only reps or timed (no distance).

Explicit set types are limited: optional auto-generated warm-up sets (toggle in My Plan; 'Add Warm-Up Set' from More menu), AMRAP sets marked '+ reps' on Max Effort Days, and timed-interval sets. No documented drop-set or failure-set type in the help center.
features.user_feedback: A 2026 third-party review claims 'frictionless logging for supersets, drop sets, AMRAP' but no official doc for drop sets (sensai.fit).

features.how: Reps in Reserve (formerly Exertion Rating/RPE) prompt after an exercise: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4+ RiR. For supersets/circuits prompt appears after all sets; can be logged manually via More menu and edited later in the log. Not for timed/distance exercises. Feeds the recommendation algorithm (consistently high RiR -> heavier).

Exercise Details screen gives 'quick access to your past workout data' (History tab with Results/Trends; notes per past session). Recommended sets are AI-generated rather than a literal copy of last session; no documented inline 'previous' column like Strong.

Every generated workout pre-fills sets, reps and weight from the algorithm (history + mStrength variation). Saved workouts can be loaded with 'Maintain sets, reps, and weight', 'Generate new sets, reps, and weight' or 'Generate new weight only' (varied rep schemes get standardized).
Per-exercise notes (More > Notes) saved per session and viewable later in History > Results; can be attached in saved workouts. No documented workout-level or set-level notes.

Supersets (2 exercises) and circuits (3+, unlimited) can be auto-generated (toggle in My Plan) or built manually via '...' > Build superset/circuit, before or during a workout. Group menu: Add Exercises, Log All Exercises, Duplicate, Normalize Weights (iOS only; same weight across group), Reorder Sections, Unbundle. Long-press to drag groups or move exercises in/out.
Tap-and-hold an exercise and drag to reorder on the Workout tab; supersets/circuits and timed intervals also drag-reorderable.

Swipe left > Replace. Replace list sortable by Best Replacements / Most Logged / Least Logged / Never Logged and filterable by Your Equipment, No Equipment, Same Equipment, Different Equipment. Replacements are also treated as preference signals by the algorithm.
features.user_feedback: Complaint: 'Difficult exercise replacement interface' (justuseapp review aggregation).

features.how: For barbell exercises: button next to History or swipe right on a set; for other plate-loaded kit (EZ bar, trap bar, Smith, yoke, leg press, hack squat, calf machine, Hammer Strength, T-bar) swipe right on a set. Uses bars/plates from available equipment; if exact weight impossible shows nearest loadable weight. No custom bar weight for barbell; not on Watch/Wear OS.

'Warm-Up Sets' toggle in My Plan > Training Format auto-adds ramping warm-up sets (increasing weight, fewer reps) to eligible exercises. Skipped for bodyweight/band, accessory/core/assisted/timed exercises, Max Effort exercises, or when working weight is too low for a useful progression.

Bodyweight exercises: Weight field only logs added resistance ('Added Weight', e.g. vest); estimated strength for bodyweight uses reps only. Assisted exercises exist (e.g. Assisted Pull Up) but how assistance is logged is not documented. Resistance bands: user defines a band collection (Handle/Mini/Loop bands, colors, tensions); band exercises are recommended by reps, not weight.

Exercises labeled 'per arm'/'per leg': reps and weight are per side; machine weight logged for one side (not doubled). Custom exercises can be marked unilateral or bilateral. Labels may not show on Watch/Wear OS.
No tempo field found in the help center (99 articles checked).
Swap menu > 'Create Workout From Scratch' builds a custom workout exercise by exercise; Android also offers 'Import Workout' from a photo/screenshot.

Log tab > workout: edit reps/sets/weight, add (+) or delete exercises; '...' to edit duration, delete, or save as a new workout. Saved workouts can be logged for a past date via 'Add as Past Workout' (date + time). Apple Health resync only same calendar day.

Notable hands-free option: AirPods Pro head gestures (nod, shake or tilt, adjustable sensitivity) log sets; Apple Watch / Wear OS logging; Timed Intervals Auto-Play advances hands-free. No documented keyboard/large-target design notes.
Once a set is logged the countdown starts automatically with tone/vibration at the end; toggle timer icon per exercise ON/OFF. Watch logging on Wear OS does NOT start the rest timer.

Rest time is generated per exercise per workout depending on difficulty/goal (longer for strength, shorter for conditioning). Adjusting it pre-workout changes all timers for that exercise; mid-workout adjustment only affects the current timer; changes don't persist to future workouts.

Settings > Workout Settings > Notifications > 'When rest timer has ended' sends a push notification when app is backgrounded/locked (sound only if app is open). Apple Watch gives haptic + audio cues but timer pauses when the screen dims (no Always On support).
iOS Live Activities on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island show current exercise, rest timer, workout duration and set/rep progress (enable in iOS Settings > Apps > Fitbod > Live Activities).

Timed exercises (custom exercises can be 'Timed'); Timed Intervals (iOS only) run exercises for a set duration with AMRAP reps, automatic rest, Auto-Play hands-free advancing, editable interval duration; rep count suggestions after each interval.

Workout timer at top of the in-progress screen (tap to pause); duration editable after logging ('Edit Workout Duration'). Workout length target 15 min-1h30 drives number of exercises (4 ex ~27-51 min, 5 ~35-60, 6 ~39-63).
Workouts can be paused (tap timer) for up to 3 hours; after that Fitbod automatically logs the workout. Apple Watch keeps tracking during pause.

'Saved Workouts': save current workout or a logged one with a name; load via Swap > Saved Workouts with 3 modes (maintain / regenerate everything / regenerate weight only). Saved workouts don't transfer between iOS and Android.
No folders for saved workouts documented in help center.

No classic multi-week program library. Instead: algorithmic daily workouts within a split; 'Focus Exercises' run a 4-week, 4-phase cycle (Build Momentum, Dial It In, Close to Peak Effort, Final Push) on main compound lifts; iOS 'On Demand Workouts' are 9 pre-built sessions (bodyweight, dumbbell, kettlebell, bands, BOSU, TRX; 15-30 min).

Automatic non-linear periodization: mStrength varies intensity/volume between sessions (heavy-low rep vs light-high rep days); Focus Exercises 4-phase/4-week cycle; Max Effort Days (ramp sets + 2 AMRAP sets) recalibrate. No user-defined %1RM blocks or scheduled deloads.
features.user_feedback: Review: 'Mechanical plateau handling (weight reduction only, not strategic deloads)' (sensai.fit 2026).

features.how: Core of the app. Inputs: goal (7 goals incl. Powerlifting, Olympic WL), experience (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced), equipment per gym, split (PPL, Upper/Lower, Full Body, Fresh Muscle Groups; more with Focus Exercises), duration, variability, warm-ups, cardio, stretching, supersets, timed intervals, injuries. Selection uses effectiveness data from 87M+ logged workouts, per-muscle recovery and explicit/implicit preferences. Workout regenerates when history, equipment or settings change (edits before Start are lost).
features.user_feedback: Common complaints: illogical exercise order/weights, repetitive after months, neglects muscle groups (justuseapp; lasta.app).

features.how: Workouts/Week as count or specific days with optional workout preview notifications; start-of-week setting (iOS). No built-in weekly planner/calendar of future workouts - help suggests saving named workouts per day as a workaround.

'Share Workout Link' sends a workout; the recipient's copy adapts sets/reps/weights to their own history (same exercises/order). Workouts with custom exercises can't be shared. Gym location (equipment) setups can also be shared.
1,600+ exercises per help center (App Store text still says 1000+; older articles 1,500+). Includes cardio, stretching/mobility, soft tissue, primers, 30+ pregnancy-safe exercises.

HD multi-angle demonstration video at top of Exercise Details plus 'How To' with step-by-step guidance and target muscle breakdown. GIFs were removed; offline playback only for previously cached videos.

Create via +Add Exercise > search > Create New Exercise: name, primary + secondary muscles, tracking (reps or timed, weighted or bodyweight), unilateral/bilateral, optional equipment. Cannot be edited after creation (delete & recreate); excluded from auto-recommendations and progression; count toward recovery and calories; no distance tracking; private.
Each exercise has Primary and secondary muscle targets (How To > Target tab). Primary sets count 1, secondary 0.5 for weekly set targets (another section says only primary counts).

Equipment is a hard filter for generation; add-exercise filter 'only exercises that match your available equipment'; categories By Equipment, Weighted, Bodyweight Only, Bodyweight with Equipment, Cardio, Stretching & Mobility, Pregnancy.
Search by keyword; tabs All / By Muscle / Categories (incl. Recently Added, Added by Me); sort alphabetically or by Most Logged.
Exercise content in app languages only: English, Spanish, Portuguese.

Every set has recommended reps/weight from logged history: comfortable completion -> gradual load/rep increase; struggle -> ease back; after a break or for new exercises -> conservative weights (seeded from aggregate data). mStrength deliberately alternates heavy/light sessions. RiR and Max Effort Day AMRAP results refine 'Estimated Strength'. Weights respect available plate/dumbbell increments.
features.user_feedback: Users often see lower-than-expected weights; Fitbod explains it as deliberate light days (help FAQ).

features.how: Progression is algorithmic (weight or reps increased); no explicit double-progression rule documented.
No user-scheduled deloads. Automatic easing: lower weights after inactivity, when strength scores decline, and mStrength light days; Focus Exercise cycle ends with a phase refresh.

Per-muscle recovery model: each muscle group 0-100%, full recovery ~6-7 days depending on volume/intensity, body stats and cardio; imported Apple Health/Health Connect/Strava/Fitbit activities affect recovery. Fresher muscles prioritized; user can manually override recovery %. Accessory muscles capped at 1-2 exercises per workout.
features.user_feedback: Review: 'Recovery estimates may not always match how users feel' (lasta.app); no HRV/sleep inputs (sensai.fit).

features.how: Not a conversational coach. 'Injuries/Limitations' uses free-text description + follow-up questions to suggest exclusions/alternatives; 'Workout Insights' (App Store event) gives coaching tips and explains why exercises were recommended; human 'Ask a Trainer' email service included in subscription.
features.user_feedback: 'a generator not a coach' - no conversational coaching or mid-workout dialogue (sensai.fit 2026).

features.how: Automatically scheduled per exercise: a few ramp-up sets then 2 AMRAP sets at working weight ('+ reps') to recalibrate Estimated Strength. Cannot be triggered manually or disabled globally (hide per exercise); not for bands/supersets/circuits, 1 per muscle per workout, paused while Focus Exercises are on.

Recommend More Often (+40-60% likelihood), Recommend Less Often (-20-40%), Don't Recommend Again (exclude, immediate). Managed per exercise from '...' or My Plan > Manage Exercises; no bulk reset. Implicit learning from skips, replaces, deletes and manual adds.
More Consistent (keeps 70-80% of exercises weekly), Balanced (default), More Variable.

My Plan > Injuries/Limitations: free text or quick area (Lower Back, Shoulder, Knee...), answer questions, get suggested exclusions/alternatives, 'Update Plan'; list shows reported date and affected exercises; 'Mark As Not Injured'. Does not override Focus Exercises.

7 goals (Build Muscle, Get Lean, Get Stronger, Reduce Bodyweight, Improve Fitness, Practice Powerlifting, Practice Olympic Weightlifting) set rep ranges (e.g., strength 4-6, hypertrophy 8-12), rest periods and cardio share; experience level unlocks exercise complexity. Neither adjusts automatically.

Per-workout tweaks via Swap menu: switch split day, pick muscles (Recovered/Push/Pull/Upper/Lower/Full Body or custom muscle set), saved workouts, create from scratch, On Demand (iOS), Import from photo (Android); Duration 15-90 min and Equipment mods for today only.
Records per exercise: Estimated Strength, Volume, Reps (max in a set), Weight (heaviest), Exercise Time, Total Time, Distance, Total Distance, Split (best pace).

'Estimated Strength' (formerly Projected 1RM) from sets/reps/weight over time with recency decay (drops if exercise not logged recently); for bodyweight exercises it's estimated max reps. Formula proprietary/not published; cannot be edited manually.
Exercise > History > Trends: select a stat to view its chart (Estimated Strength etc.); Focus Exercise progress cards on Body tab with e1RM, PRs and averages.

Weekly Set Targets tab: model-generated working sets per muscle per week (from goal, frequency, duration, experience, gender/body comp); completion %; not editable. Workout Report shows Muscle Volume per muscle group by week/month/6m/year/custom.
features.user_feedback: Targets not editable (top feature request); algorithm does not guarantee hitting targets (help center).

features.how: Body tab > Recovery: rotatable front/back avatar heat map of muscle recovery; tap a muscle for workout/recovery history; post-workout heat map of muscles worked. Strava posts include a 'Muscle Impact' image.

Weekly streak = consecutive weeks meeting Workouts/Week goal (no grace period); shown on Log tab; workout report calendar up to 365 days; Milestones badges (volume [lbs only], workouts, calories); Year In Review report.

Post-workout summary with Apple Health sync toggle and share cards (Instagram Stories etc.) showing achievements; Wear OS summary shows exercises, calories, volume. Weekly/monthly Workout Report (in-app + email) with totals vs previous period.

Exercise Percentile Ranking (rolling out 2026): 'Top X% of Fitbodders like you' vs users of similar age, gender, bodyweight; shown only if within ~top 40% (Top 40% to Top 1%), for ~100 supported exercises, per exercise & stat. Also mStrength per-muscle score and Overall Strength Score (unlocks after >=6 sets per primary muscle across Push/Pull/Legs).
Calories from sets, estimated duration, exercise type and bodyweight; with Apple Watch/Health Connect uses heart rate, age, weight, gender (uses wearable calories if provided). Not manually editable.

Live BPM, avg/min/max and sparkline during workouts from Apple Watch or AirPods Pro 3 (iOS 26+) or any BLE heart-rate broadcaster on Android (Garmin, Polar, WHOOP). Display only - not used for calories or recommendations.
Weight synced from Apple Health/Health Connect (incl. smart scales) or entered manually in Body > Composition; trend over week/month/6m/year.

Body Composition: weight, body fat %, lean mass (both OS), BMI and waist circumference (iOS), BMR (Android). Manual entries stay in Fitbod (not written to Health). No limb circumference set documented.
No progress-photo feature found in the help center.
Recovery is modeled only from logged/imported workouts; reviewers note no HRV, sleep or readiness inputs.

Write workouts, active energy, heart rate; read compatible workouts (runs, walks, cycles, elliptical, rower, hiking, swims) which affect recovery; read/write body comp (weight, BF%, lean mass, BMI, waist, height) and profile data. Sync toggle on summary; resync only same day.
features.user_feedback: Older versions (<=8.15) silently lost Health permission (help center).

features.how: Apple Watch companion (watchOS 10+): log sets, edit reps/weight/distance/duration/resistance/incline/band, add/remove sets (max 9), rest timer, live HR, RiR prompts; starting, swapping/adding exercises and saving require iPhone; no Always On. Wear OS app: start, view, log/add sets, finish; no rest timer from watch logging; must be in Bluetooth range.
features.user_feedback: Most common complaint: Watch sync unreliable, timer stopping (justuseapp; help troubleshooting article).

features.how: No native Garmin app. Strava (import public activities, post Fitbod workouts with muscle impact image), Fitbit (iOS only; import running/biking/stair/elliptical/walk; posting requires manual add in Fitbit since Oct 2024), BLE heart-rate monitors (Garmin/Polar/WHOOP broadcast) on Android, AirPods Pro for gesture logging/HR.
No Strong/Hevy/CSV import. Imports cardio activities from Apple Health, Health Connect, Strava, Fitbit; Android can import a workout from a photo/screenshot.
Log tab > gear > 'Export Workout Data' produces a CSV (per-set weights/reps grouped by workout, warm-ups, timed sets, notes, unit) - documented by third parties; no help-center article.

Account required (email, Apple, Google, Facebook); workouts sync to servers; history, gym profiles and subscription transfer across iOS/Android (saved workouts don't). Local data syncs when back online.
iOS home-screen/Today widget (small & medium): workouts this week vs weekly goal ring and next workout details.
Not mentioned in help center.
Multiple gym locations, each with its own equipment (My Plan > Location > Add New Location); switch, rename, share (recipient imports setup) or delete. Units must be changed manually per location.
Edit available weight increments for dumbbells, kettlebells, barbells; bars/plates for plate calculator; custom resistance band collection with colors/tension.
Only exercises matching selected equipment are generated (hard filter); Bodyweight-Only mode; per-day equipment mod.
Clubs (beta, select gyms, new signups only): gym-based activity feed where completed workouts auto-post and members react with emojis. No general social network.
Share summary image cards to Instagram Stories etc.; share workout link; Strava posting.
features.user_feedback: App Store review: aggressive promotional messaging when sharing workouts.

features.how: Clubs weekly leaderboard (Volume and Workouts, Sun-Sat), top 3 announced Mondays; beta, gyms with >=5 active members. Fitbod for Business admin dashboard has weekly leaderboards.
Only in Fitbod for Business: custom company-wide challenges with Fitbod-sponsored prizes.
No trainer/client tooling; business offering is a corporate wellness admin dashboard (usage stats, leaderboards), not coaching.
No program assignment; nearest is sharing a workout link (adapts to recipient).
'Ask a Trainer': email certified Fitbod trainers (in-app form or trainer@fitbod.me), replies in a few business days; no custom plans, nutrition or medical advice.
Ask a Trainer is email-only; no in-app chat with a coach documented.
No coach/program marketplace found.

No free tier: 7-day trial (requires choosing monthly/yearly plan) then $15.99/mo or $95.99/yr (US; legacy $12.99/$79.99 and lower). After expiry can view history but not log new workouts. Lifetime (only ~1,000 sold at Black Friday), Family Plan (Duo 2 / Family 5, annual only, web purchase), Fitbod for Business (5-100+ seats), HSA/FSA eligible, monthly subscription pause offers.
features.user_feedback: Price is a frequent complaint; 3-workout free limit in older versions (TechRadar 2023).

features.how: Global lb/kg in My Plan > Preferences > Units (one system for weight and distance); per-exercise kg/lb override for weight exercises (More menu). Past workouts keep original units. Milestones show lbs only.
No theme setting documented; App Store reviewer asks for color/theme personalization.
English, Spanish, Portuguese; follows device language, per-app language override.
App Store: developer has not indicated accessibility features.
Onboarding questions on experience, goals, equipment (web or app) then first workout generated immediately; Clubs gym selection during setup.
Offline: local algorithm generates workouts, log/save workouts (sync later), cached thumbnails/videos. Online needed for Focus Exercise split alignment, uncached videos, full records/history.

Account required. Stores body profile, workout data, preferences; GDPR-compliant deletion (in-app Permanently Delete Account). App Store label: Usage Data used to track; Health & Fitness, contact info, identifiers linked to you.

iPhone (iOS 18+; current & previous major), Apple Watch (watchOS 10+), Android (current & previous major), Wear OS; Mac with Apple silicon via App Store; iPad not officially supported; website only for onboarding/subscription.

Optional warm-up/cool-down blocks: soft tissue, dynamic, static stretches, primers (iOS); each type set to warm-up or cool-down; and optional cardio at start/end with chosen modalities, duration auto-set by goal.
